name: Kiseki Maigo no Tenshi
source:
London, 19th century. Hero is private detective investigating a series of women murders. The story starts when an angel falls on him on a deep foggy night.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-october-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
伦敦，十九世纪。英雄是一名私家侦探，调查一系列女性谋杀案。故事开始于一个大雾之夜，天使降临在他身上。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-october-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
